Folder layout is the npm package layout (build/, examples/jsm/...), only a subset of files: the addons'
relative imports resolve. npm 0.187 ships no *.min.js, so build/three.module.js (+ three.core.js) is used.

How pages load it: importmap -> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.187.0/... ; editor/html_render.py answers
those requests from this folder (laptop + cloud, the cloud packer ships it). See graphics_kit/THREE.md.
To add an addon: copy it (and the files it imports with ./ or ../) from the same npm version, same path.
